meta.tagline: Learn from content creators who ship real work
meta.defaultDescription: Mujtamaaty is a bilingual, community-first learning platform — every content creator runs one community that bundles their courses, and students subscribe to unlock everything inside and join the discussion.

home.heroTitle: Join a content creator's community, unlock every course inside, and learn alongside people building the same thing
home.heroSubtitle: Mujtamaaty connects content creators who build real products with students who want to learn by doing — in Arabic and English, side by side.
home.heroImageAlt: A content creator recording a lesson for their students
home.latestSubtitle: Fresh from our content creators this month
home.topCreatorsSubtitle: The people teaching what they actually build
home.ctaBannerSubtitle: Build your community, publish courses inside it, and get paid for every subscriber.
home.privacyBody: Your data is stored and used only to provide the platform's services — signing in, managing your community subscriptions, and tracking your course progress. We don't share your data with third parties except where required by law or to complete an actual payment. You can request to update or delete your data at any time from your profile page.
home.termsBody: By using the platform, you agree to use its content for personal learning only, without republishing or reselling any course or educational material. Subscribing to a community grants access for the specified subscription period only, and each content creator is responsible for the quality and accuracy of the content they publish. The platform reserves the right to suspend any account that violates these rules.
home.privacyImageAlt: A digital lock symbolizing protection of user data
home.termsImageAlt: An agreement document symbolizing the platform's terms of use
